fields.Institution: NIMT Institute of Technology and Management
fields.Approval / Accreditation: AICTE approval/status to verify for current PGDM intake
fields.Intake — Published:
120 PGDM seats at Ghaziabad (Arthala), official 2026–27 programme page. The previous 60-seat figure concerned Greater Noida.
Published numeric intake: 120
fields.Fees — Published:
Ghaziabad PGDM: displayed total ₹4,56,750 = Year 1 ₹2,25,000 + Year 2 ₹2,31,750. Registration ₹1,500 separately listed; confirm whether additional. Prior ₹4,62,750 with uniform was Greater Noida, not this campus.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 4.5675
fields.Fee Scope: Official displayed two-year Ghaziabad programme fee. Separately listed ₹1,500 registration may make cash outlay ₹4,58,250; hostel/living extra.
fields.Accepted Exams: CMAT, MAT, CAT, GMAT or legacy UPSEE listed as optional; official page also permits direct merit admission.
fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff: CAT accepted / low cutoff not disclosed
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree with at least 50%; current official page advertises direct admission without an entrance exam.
fields.Selection Process: Online application and academic eligibility, followed by group discussion and personal interview; offer/allotment and seat confirmation. Entrance test stated optional.
fields.Avg CTC — Published: No formal PGDM mean located. Secondary ₹4.8 lakh statistic is inconsistently labelled average and median.
fields.Placement Scope: No verified Ghaziabad PGDM cohort mean/median/rate. Official ₹4–8 L early-career salary guide and group alumni are career context, not placement statistics.
fields.Official Role Examples: Business Manager; Marketing Manager; Finance Analyst; HR Manager — official programme career examples, not verified cohort placements.
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Business/Strategy Consultant; Product/Program Manager; Operations; Sales/Brand; Finance Analyst
fields.Notes: Current official NIMT fee and course pages provide a substantially lower programme total than the first workbook. The site uses both PGDM-GN and MBA labels, so credential nomenclature must be confirmed on the offer letter/AICTE approval. | Final audit: Verified the dedicated Ghaziabad (Arthala) page: 120 seats and displayed two-year fee ₹4,56,750. Greater Noida intake and uniform charges have been removed from this campus record. The page permits optional entrance scores or direct merit admission and lists GD/PI. Current EOA and registration inclusion still require confirmation.
fields.Average Evidence: Secondary ₹4.8 lakh salary is labelled average on the course page and median on comparison page; unresolved.
fields.Current Audit Note: 18 Oct 2026 public-source review. Checked: Corrected Greater Noida data assigned to Ghaziabad: dedicated Ghaziabad page confirms 120 seats and ₹4,56,750 displayed total.. fields.Research CTC basis:
Shiksha PGDM course page calls ₹4.8 lakh an average; its comparison page calls it a median. No formal cohort report resolves the metric.
